en.t: Doctor Honma was a practitioner of Chinese medicine.

units.source_text: 不过哥哥觉得他是个庸医，很是瞧不起他。

en.t: But my elder brother thought he was a quack and looked down on him deeply.

units.source_text: 在他帮母亲看病的时候，哥哥始终双臂交叉站在一旁，用怀疑的眼光旁观。

en.t: When he examined Mother, my brother always stood to one side with his arms crossed, watching with suspicion.

units.source_text: 本间说母亲脸上长的是面疮。

en.t: Honma said that what had appeared on Mother's face was facial sores.

units.source_text: 其实面疮这个病原本不是什么恶疾，动手术切掉就好了。

en.t: In fact, this illness called facial sores was not originally anything malignant; it could be cured simply by cutting them away in an operation.

units.source_text: 但是可悲的是当时根本做不了手术。

en.t: But the sad thing was that at the time surgery was simply impossible.

units.source_text: 只能煎药服用，买水蛭吸掉伤口上的血。

en.t: All they could do was decoct medicine for her to drink and buy leeches to draw blood from the wound.

units.source_text: 父亲日日守在母亲床边，按照本间大夫的药方煎药。

en.t: Father stayed by Mother's bedside day after day, decocting medicine according to Doctor Honma's prescription.

units.source_text: 哥哥每天取十五钱到外面买水蛭。

en.t: Every day my brother took fifteen sen and went out to buy leeches.

units.source_text: 就连我……我也瞒着哥哥，跑到离家最近的稻荷神社为母亲祈福。

en.t: Even I... I too slipped away without my brother knowing and ran to the Inari shrine nearest our house to pray for Mother.

units.source_text: ——因为这件事，全家人都无暇顾忌雏人偶。

en.t: Because of this, no one in the family had any time to concern themselves with the hina dolls.

units.source_text: 不，准确的说，全家人连看一眼堆在墙边的三十几个桐木箱子的心情都没有。

en.t: No, to be more precise, no one in the family even felt like glancing at the thirty-odd paulownia boxes piled against the wall.
